---
description: Execute the implementation planning workflow using the plan template to generate design artifacts.
---

The user input to you can be provided directly by the agent or as a command argument.

1. Run `.specify/scripts/bash/check-prerequisites.sh --json` and read FEATURE_DIR.
2. Read the feature spec and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`.
3. Fill `plan.md` from `.specify/templates/plan-template.md`.
